_note: Single source of truth for the Claude model fleet. Resolve it with .claude/scripts/model-fleet.sh — never hardcode a model name in a new skill, rule, or agent body. When the fleet changes, editing this file is sufficient for every consumer that resolves through the script. `display` values are versionless family names (issue #791): every human-facing mention across CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules/, .claude/skills/, and .claude/agents/ names the family, so a new model within an existing family needs no edit here or anywhere else — only a genuinely new family, or a change of top_tier, does. `id` stays fully versioned because tools consume that string literally. Enforced by .github/scripts/chip-model-guard-lint.sh.
